page.overview:
Who is Darth Ruyn?

Darth Ruyn was an aged Twi'lek Sith Lord who served the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt and his One Sith. He instructed several apprentices in the Sith arts, including the female Twi'lek Darth Talon.

In 137 ABY, seven years after Krayt deposed Galactic Emperor Roan Fel and established his Galactic Empire on the galaxy, Ruyn completed Talon's training and presented his apprentice to his Lord. As Talon's final test, Krayt commanded her to kill Ruyn, whom she respected and cared for, but a task she nevertheless completed without hesitation. Ruyn made no attempt to block her decapitating strike.

Old at the time of the conflict between the Sith-backed Fel Empire and the Galactic Alliance beginning in 127 ABY—known as the Sith–Imperial War—the Twi'lek Darth Ruyn was a Sith Lord While teaching his apprentice, Ruyn would often take her to the Sith Art Chamber within the Temple of the Sith on Coruscant, as he found it conducive to meditation.

In 137 ABY, seven years after Krayt deposed Galactic Emperor Roan Fel and established his Sith Empire at the end of the Sith-Imperial War, Ruyn completed Talon's training and presented his apprentice to Krayt. The Dark Lord gave Talon one final test: to kill her Master, whom she respected and cared for. Talon carried out Krayt's order without hesitation, decapitating Ruyn with a sweep of her lightsaber. Having passed the test, Talon was given her Sith name and promoted to the position of Krayt's Hand—his own personal assassin.
